fullContent:
Kottamchukkadi Thailam (Oil) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sahasra Yoga, Taila Prakarana – 12 
 Introduction 
 Kottamchukkadi Thailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic oil preparation which is used in the treatment of Vata disorders like neuro muscular pains, sciatica, spondylitis etc. 
 Ingredients 
 21 grams of each of:- 
 
 Kottam – Saussurea lappa 
 Chukku – Ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Vayambu – Acorus calamus 
 Shigru – Moringa oliefera 
 Lashuna – Garlic – Alium sativum 
 Karotti – Capparis sepiaria 
 Devadruma – Cedrus deodara 
 Siddartha – Mustard – Brassica juncea 
 Suvaha – Rasna – Pluchea lanceolata 
 Tila taila – Oil of Sesasmum indicum – 768 ml 
 Dadhi – Curd – 768 ml 
 Chincha rasa – Tamarind juice – 3.072 liter 
 
 Indications 
 
 Pain and Inflammation 
 Arthritis 
 Sciatica 
 Myalgia 
 Spondylitis 
 
 How to Use? 
 For external use only. 
 Side Effects 
 There are no known side effects of this oil on external application. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
